annotations.title: utilpeek: convert data between JSON, YAML, CSV, TOML and XML

description: utilpeek: Convert data between JSON, YAML, CSV, TOML and XML. To check JSON against a schema use validate_json. Returns the document converted from json, yaml, csv, toml or xml to json, yaml, csv or toml. YAML uses libyaml's restricted loader (alias bombs refused). Parsed YAML keys that become identical return 422 not_representable. The loader can still collapse duplicate or equivalent keys. XML with DTDs or entities returns 422 xml_forbidden. CSV values stay strings; dates become ISO strings (native dates in TOML). Parsed in an isolated, resource-limited child process without network; input over its limits is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 1 s, up to a few seconds for 1 MB. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/convert-data-formats-api.html

from.description: Input format: json, yaml, csv, toml or xml.

input.description: The document as a string (at most 1 MB UTF-8).

to.description: Output format: json, yaml, csv or toml.

name: convert_data

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
